short_description: Hamburg-headquartered German mobility-safety startup, founded in 2019 by Alex Kasinec, Andrew Moakes and co-founders, developing a portable LiDAR-based collision-warning and situational-awareness system for complex ground movements of large objects, primarily aircraft on airport aprons and in hangars. Reported to have raised approximately USD 4.1 million in a Seed round in September 2025.
